SASBDB entry SASDNP7  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDNP7/)

Publication: Medical contrast agents as promising tools for biomacromolecular SAXS experiments.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1107/S2059798322007392

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDNP7/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
